schema.description: Canonical schema discriminator. Aligned with schema-registry.json; lets validators distinguish identity registry receipts from other receipt envelopes (e.g. audit-ryw-receipt, event-batch-receipt).

subject_did.description: Method-native bare DID whose exact accepted log entry at seq is committed by accepted_entry_digest. This identifies method history, not an Arkret business principal.

accepted_entry_digest.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS of the exact complete accepted method-native log entry, including its control proofs. It commits to immutable accepted bytes at subject_did and seq, not a PCR Event or an unsigned-operation projection. Receipts with different digests at the same position MUST NOT contribute to the same consensus quorum.

registry_id.description: Stable did_core_id of the registry service issuing the receipt. The detached proof verification_method remains a DID URL and MUST project to this value through the registered method adapter.

witness_role.description: Issuer's role in the DID registry consensus group. Required so verifiers can apply role-specific freshness / quorum rules; an absent role would force the verifier to guess writer vs replica semantics.

audience.description: Optional audience binding (verifier DID, service DID, or domain). When present, verifiers MUST reject the receipt outside that audience context to prevent cross-protocol reuse.

signature.description: Registry detached proof. payload_digest = sha256(canonical_json(receipt with signature omitted)). The detached JWS signs canonical_json({context:'ak.identity_receipt_proof.v1', payload_digest, registry_id, subject_did, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?}); context is a fixed signing-context domain tag and is not a wire field. signature.created_at MUST equal receipt.created_at. signature.verification_method MUST be a currently valid DID URL assertion method whose DID component is independently validated and projected to registry_id by the registered method adapter. Receipt audience and proof audience MUST either both be absent or be the same single string; array-valued proof audiences are invalid for this object family.
